scientific_integrity: Exact complete enumeration of all 504 undirected Hamiltonian paths through two different methods; standalone source checkers and explicit proofs of the reductions and quotient symmetry; no outside independent scholarly audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite statement about the fourteen-vertex Heawood graph; not a family theorem or mixing-time bound. The F056B identification invokes published Foster census classification. Historical priority is not established, and the full text of Kazazi (2026) was not accessible.
title: The Klein graph hidden in Heawood backbite dynamics
